messages:
Alex: Night handoff — leaving notes for morning. TL;DR: short outage window on KV-cache read path, mitigations applied, paused a model rollout. Details below.

Alex: Timeline: ~18:20 UTC saw p95 read latency jump from ~70ms to ~420ms -> embedding reads started returning 503s for ~5% of requests. Autoscaler didn't scale fast enough for one shard.

Alex: Mitigation steps taken: 1) Circuit-breaker tripped for heavy-prefetch route; 2) Rerouted traffic to fallback model-variant 'embed-v1-small' for tier B customers; 3) Added one additional cache node (scale +1) and evicted stale prefixes. Canary rollout 'rtk-quantizer' paused via rollout pause.

Alex: Commands I ran:
```bash
# add cache node
kubectl -n infra scale statefulset kv-cache --replicas=5
# check cache evictions
redis-cli -h kv-cache-svc INFO | grep -i evicted_keys
```

Maya: Acked. Logged INC-4321 with initial postmortem skeleton. Will pick up verifying backlog of failed requests and correlate with client retries. Taking ownership for postmortem.

Jordan: Noted. I'll follow up on the canary metrics — pinging infra to see whether kernel-level OOMs happened on that node. @OpsBot can you share the node-level metrics for node kv-3?

OpsBot: Metrics snapshot uploaded: https://metrics.redwood.internal/dashboards/kv-cache/2005/summary — p95 CPU spiked to 88% between 18:15-18:30, network rx spikes present. (auto-upload)

Sam: Quick note — several customers on Dedicated saw higher retry rates. I've opened support case CS-998. For next steps, prioritize (1) confirm no data loss, (2) finish correlation for retries -> 3) decide on soft-prewarmed cache policy.

Maya: For morning: I'll run range of checks:
- reconcile failed request ids (INC-4321) with trace ids
- sanity-check rollback readiness for rtk-quantizer (command: `kubectl -n models rollout status deploy/rtk-quantizer`)
- validate KV cache TTL and pre-warm settings

Jordan: Also recommend we schedule a short postmortem sync at 10:00 PT tomorrow. I'll drop a calendar invite.

Alex: Thanks all. Leaving runbook updates under /runbooks/kv-cache.md — note added "scale +1 then wait 120s before traffic shift". If any urgent regressions overnight @Maya -> escalate to SRE rotation.

Sam: One more: left a short script to dump recent errors:
```python
# dump errors last 2h
from infra.logs import query
print(query('service:kv-cache AND level:error', last_hours=2))
```

OpsBot: Reminder: canary auto-pause triggered at 18:22 UTC. Flagged in the release system.

Alex: Signing off. :wave: Please add any follow-ups here.
